ShareMenuPlugin.title: Share View
ShareMenuPlugin.helpBody: Generate a shareable link that captures the current view, including the selected satellite, search, propagation rate, and camera angle. The link opens at the recipient's live time unless you turn on "Include current time", which pins the simulation time. Open this menu to create the link on demand, then copy it or use your device's share sheet. The URL bar is no longer rewritten automatically as you explore; enable "Live URL bar updates" in the settings to restore that behavior.

labels.includeTimeTooltip: Pin the current simulation time in the link. Off by default so recipients see the same view at their own live time.

toasts.copyFailed: Failed to copy link to clipboard.
